notes.title: Release Notes for 26/04/2024
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

notes.title: Release Notes for 18/04/2024
notes.content:
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Damage Reduction:[/b] All damage received from enemies has been reduced by half.
[*] [b]Health Rune:[/b] Now restores health for every 5 enemies killed instead of 2.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Rage Mode:[/b] Fixed an issue where players remained stuck in Rage Mode.
[*] [b]Gamepad:[/b] Fixed a bug that interfered with performing Glory Kills using a gamepad.
[*] [b]Language:[/b] Fixed texts with missing localization settings.
[*] [b]Save Slots:[/b] Fixed an issue that caused save slots to display "Unknown" as the location.
[/list]
